subject: arcadeCabinet
pitch:
Category: Object.
Subject: 1980s arcade cabinet.
Style: synthwave.

requests.what: Large glowing SYNTHWAVE arcade logo across the marquee: angular 1980s lettering in CYAN, MAGENTA, and WHITE, with a dark outline and tiny starbursts.
Paint the screen as a deep indigo CRT display with horizontal CYAN scanlines, subtle MAGENTA bloom, a bright pixel horizon, and a tiny retro game HUD.
On the control deck, add a black joystick pedestal with a glowing MAGENTA ball, six chunky arcade buttons alternating CYAN and MAGENTA, and two small START buttons.
Decorate the coin panel with two brass coin slots, a bright CYAN return button, small MAGENTA indicator lamps, and engraved 1980s arcade lettering.
A long angular MAGENTA lightning-bolt neon graphic running up the cabinet side, with a thin CYAN offset glow and small geometric star decals.
Mirror the long angular MAGENTA lightning-bolt neon graphic on the opposite cabinet side, with a thin CYAN offset glow and small geometric star decals.
A narrow synthwave light bar across the cabinet roof: a dark housing, six alternating CYAN and MAGENTA lamps, and two small chrome brackets.
A compact rear ventilation grille made from seven evenly spaced dark METAL slats with CYAN end caps, inset into the upper rear housing.
A thick coiled BLACK power cable dropping from the rear, with a MAGENTA plug head and a small CYAN strain-relief ring.
A thin glowing floor halo beneath the cabinet, a rounded rectangular strip alternating CYAN and MAGENTA like reflected neon on a dark arcade floor.

Paint the side panel with a deep violet-to-purple synthwave gradient, hard-edged CYAN and MAGENTA geometric bands, tiny stars, and a subtle black grid. Keep the large central area readable for the lightning graphic.
Add a restrained dark purple synthwave panel pattern to the lower front: thin MAGENTA corner lines, CYAN pinstripes, and a small centered retro badge, leaving the coin panel clear.
Paint the control deck BLACK with a glossy violet edge, fine CYAN pinstripes, and a subtle diagonal MAGENTA circuit pattern around the button area.
